pak.why: Pak session f3, 20 Oct 2026: regional buses take VZ-ODIS-bus; the town buses of Třinec, Český Těšín and Frýdek-Místek take their town packages. A regional bus (kraj logo) lent to a town line keeps its VZ-ODIS-bus object. Transdev Slezsko's 3ČSAD white-green (with or without the kraj logo) is 3csadbilozelena, the red-black ODIS scheme odiscervenocerna.

texts.lede_who: The ODIS bus lines of four regional contract areas (Českotěšínsko, Frýdecko-Místecko, Frýdlantsko and Jablunkovsko–Třinecko, Transdev Slezsko) and of the town networks of Český Těšín and Třinec (ARRIVA autobusy) and Frýdek-Místek (Transdev Slezsko)
texts.swap_places: Třinec, Český Těšín, Jablunkov, Frýdek-Místek and Frýdlant
texts.scope: Licences with the area prefixes 871 (Českotěšínsko), 863 (Frýdecko-Místecko), 864 (Frýdlantsko), 861 (Jablunkovsko–Třinecko) of Transdev Slezsko, 865 (MHD Frýdek-Místek) of Transdev Slezsko and 875 (MHD Český Těšín) and 866 (MHD Třinec) of ARRIVA autobusy
texts.scope_check: The prefixes match the live map (provozovna Český Těšín, Frýdek-Místek (which runs Frýdecko-Místecko and Frýdlantsko), Jablunkov; ARRIVA Třinec) and the kraj’s list of contract areas.
texts.buses_extra: ARRIVA’s town buses and Z-Group’s buses on 980 and 985 are not in the Transdev register: their plates were looked up on seznam-autobusu.cz vehicle pages (01b_plates.py). The two Český Těšín buses with vanity plates, TESIN 001 and TESIN 004, are in the register as “001 TESIN” and “004 TESIN”: Scania Citywide LF 10,9M of 2018 in the town’s white-yellow livery.
texts.unmodelled_intro: Shift lines and sparse lines whose stops other lines already serve (method Step 8: a long-interval line only where it is a place’s only service), a line whose afternoon trips are part of another line’s round (315, in 316), and lines with no trips on the day.
texts.depots: Transdev Slezsko branches (provozovny) and ARRIVA’s Třinec garage, which runs both the Třinec and the Český Těšín town lines. A seen bus counts at the branch the live map reports for it; a designed bus at its home branch.

network_state: Four regional contract areas and three town networks

Českotěšínsko (licences 871xxx), Frýdecko-Místecko (863xxx), Frýdlantsko (864xxx, added 21 Oct) and Jablunkovsko–Třinecko (861xxx, one area) of Transdev Slezsko; the town lines of Frýdek-Místek (865xxx, Transdev Slezsko), Český Těšín (875xxx) and Třinec (866xxx), both ARRIVA autobusy. Each has its own section below.
Diversion timetables to the end of the timetable year
